reviews.author: Angelie G…
reviews.body: The best experience I’ve ever had doing my lashes! Thalia was so nice, professional & caring! Her attention to detail is incredible. 10/10!

reviews.author: Maria A…
reviews.body: I absolutely love my lashes!! 💘 Also I always have amazing retention! my lashes last such a long time every single time. I’ve been going to her for almost three years now, and I honestly wouldn’t change her for anyone. She’s the best at what she does, and I always leave feeling so happy with my lashes.

reviews.author: Oneida R…
reviews.body: Thalía es súper cariñosa, atenta y profesional, se tomó el tiempo de escuchar exactamente lo que yo quería y el resultado quedó más hermoso de lo que esperaba. Las pestañas quedaron perfectas, naturales y súper bien hechas. Sin duda la recomiendo al 100% y volveré sin pensarlo 💖✨
